# [TASK] ai-service: multi-language Vosk model loading (English + German)

## Task
Extend `SpeechToTextService` to hold and select between English and German
Vosk models by request language.

## Scope
Backend model-loading/selection only. Command parsing changes are Task #214.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `/speech-to-text` accepts a language parameter (`en`/`de`, case-insensitive), defaulting to English when omitted (`AiServiceIntegrationTest.speechToTextPassesLanguageParameterThrough`, `SpeechToTextServiceTest.transcribeDefaultsToEnglishWhenLanguageOmitted`, `transcribeNormalizesGermanLanguageCase`, `transcribeNormalizesEnglishLanguageCase`)
- [x] Both models lazy-load independently, same lazy/double-checked-locking pattern as today (`getOrLoadModel` keyed per language with its own monitor in `loadLocks`; `SpeechToTextServiceTest.transcribeKeepsLanguagesIndependentAfterOneFails`)
- [x] Missing model directory for one language doesn't break the other language or ai-service startup (`SpeechToTextServiceTest.transcribeDegradesWhenEnglishModelMissing`, `transcribeDegradesWhenGermanModelMissing`)
- [x] `infrastructure/scripts/download-vosk-model.sh` and `backend/ai-service/Dockerfile` fetch and verify both languages' archives (English: `vosk-model-en-us-0.22-lgraph`, German: `vosk-model-small-de-0.15`, per ADR-021) — the SHA256 checksums pinned for the two archives are unverified placeholders, tracked as #229, which must land before #200 closes
- [x] Unit tests cover both languages' missing-model error path, language defaulting/validation/case-normalization, and multi-model `destroy()` cleanup (`SpeechToTextServiceTest`: `transcribeRejectsUnsupportedLanguage`, `transcribeAfterDestroyThrowsCleanError`, `destroyClosesEveryLoadedModel`; `AiServiceIntegrationTest.speechToTextPassesLanguageParameterThrough`)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 6

## Notes
Model choice per ADR-021 (`docs/architecture/adr/021-vosk-bilingual-model-selection.md`).

ai-service's k8s memory limits were raised 384Mi/768Mi to 512Mi/1024Mi as a conservative but unmeasured buffer for two resident models. ADR-021 asks for real combined-RSS measurement before trusting that headroom. The ADR's fallback (evict-on-switch instead of a limit bump) is still available.

Checksum pinning for the two archives is still open as #229.
